title: Project onboard
description: Make a repo or folder ready for autonomous sessions: CLAUDE.md, test command, epics, a sane grant template.

steps.name: inspect
steps.prompt: You are onboarding this folder into the control plane. Read README, docs, manifests and the last 30 commits. Produce ONBOARDING.md in the folder with: what this project is, how to build and test it (exact commands, verified by running them), the integration branch, and the five most valuable open items with file references.

steps.name: claude-md
steps.prompt: If CLAUDE.md is missing or thin, write one: build and test commands, code style rules evident from the codebase, what never to touch, how to name branches (jj/<topic>) and commit messages. Keep it under 80 lines. Do not push.

steps.name: register
steps.prompt: Use the control plane API at $API_URL (curl is fine; JSON responses). Useful routes: GET /projects, GET /projects/:id, GET /sessions, GET /sessions/:id/events, GET /graph/:id, GET /workflows, GET /workflows/:id, GET /brief?hours=N, GET /audit?limit=N, GET /chores, GET /ledgers?status=signed, GET /proposals, POST /workflows, POST /projects, POST /projects/:id/continue, POST /chores, POST /tasks/:id/go. Create or update the project for this folder: title, goal from ONBOARDING.md, defaultMode assist, continueSteps of orient/implement/review, and a grant template limited to Read, Glob, Grep and the test command. Then print the project id.

steps.name: review
steps.prompt: Review ONBOARDING.md and CLAUDE.md for accuracy against the code. List anything that is wrong or unverified. Do not edit.
